audits.summary: AUDIT COMPLETE: The clio-agent core contains 46 case-specific contamination points across the EarthScope/GNSS/station/seismic/SAC dimension. Major contamination zones: (1) State inference layer (app.py lines 3714-5800): Multiple _infer_* functions hard-code NDP/EarthScope domain state models (_EARTHSCOPE_METADATA_RESOURCE_NAMES, metadata_only status, station_catalog extraction, 'gnss_timeseries_plot' artifacts, score=3/2/1 progression). (2) Tool implementation layer (ndp_server.py, sac_server.py): Tools hard-wired to EarthScope service URLs, station naming patterns [A-Z0-9]{3,5}[._-][A-Z0-9]{2}[._-]LY, CSV column expectations (Site, Latitude, Longitude, time/east/north/up), error code namespacing. (3) Agent loop orchestration (app.py lines 7195-12650): Large conditional blocks in planner and state updater routing to NDP workflows, tracking station search coverage, validating acquisition readiness against domain-specific state models. (4) Expert blueprints (app.py lines 14160-14224): Hardcoded 'ndp_catalog', 'sac_format' expert definitions with domain keywords and tool allocations. (5) Planner signature (agent.py, signatures/main_agent_sig.py): Recovery guidance explicitly naming 'sac_fetch_earthscope_waveform'. All detected contamination must be extracted: tools to clio-kit MCPs (earthscope, sac, ndp MCPs), state models to specialized expert/MCP, workflow orchestration to case-specific expert packs, expert blueprints to YAML-based discovery. Core agent must retain only universal framework + tool call/result normalization.

audits.summary: ADVERSARIAL AUDIT SUMMARY: The clio-agent core exhibits SUBSTANTIAL case-specific contamination across WILDFIRE/SMOKE (3 findings) and EARTHSCOPE/GNSS/SEISMIC (14 findings), plus mass-spec (1), and multi-domain issues (3). CRITICAL ISSUES: (1) Hardcoded 'earthscope_converted_data.csv' filename constant appears in 8 locations; (2) NDP workflow state inference functions (~500+ lines total in app.py) encode deep EarthScope semantics (station catalog filtering, GNSS time-series CSV columns, station ID regex patterns); (3) SAC waveform recovery logic in agent.py hardcoded to EarthScope-specific tools; (4) Geospatial/fire workflow state sanitization with USGS|UNAVCO|EarthScope|SCEC provenance patterns; (5) Explicit 'downwind_impact' expert scope in tool catalog (appears to be wildfire-specific); (6) Wildfire domain examples in geospatial tool docstrings (fire perimeters, smoke-forecast polygons, AirNow monitor logic); (7) Geospatial layer resolution logic with hardcoded fire/smoke naming conventions. STATIC TOOL CATALOG: All domain expert ownership (ndp_catalog, sac_format, geospatial, genomics, materials, imaging, mass_spec, terrain_derivation, hpc) is hardcoded. CLEANUP PATH: Move all _infer_ndp_* and _sanitize_geospatial_* functions to marketplace packs or clio-kit MCPs. Refactor tool catalog to dynamic registry. Delete or genericize domain-specific filename patterns, recovery logic, and provenance validators.

SEVERE contamination of clio-agent core framework with domain/case-specific semantics at the tool layer. The tool gateway couples 10+ domain-specific FastMCP servers (ndp, sac, genomics, imaging, mass_spec, materials, hpc, terrain, geospatial) directly into the core codebase via hardcoded mounts and routing prefixes. The TOOL_CATALOG encodes expert ownership with case-specific IDs (ndp_catalog, sac_format) and visibility scopes (downwind_impact, geography). App.py contains 1000+ lines of EarthScope/station/seismic domain logic for workflow state inference, validation, and sanitization. NDP_server and sac_server implement complete domain-specific tool implementations (station filtering, waveform discovery, trace statistics) rather than simple atomic operations. Gateway _infer_tool_server uses 14+ hardcoded if/elif branches for prefix matching. All of this must migrate to clio-kit MCP packs to achieve a clean universal framework.

audits.summary: CRITICAL CONTAMINATION INVENTORY: The clio-agent core framework is severely contaminated with case-specific (EarthScope GNSS, seismic SAC, geospatial wildfire) domain logic. 32 distinct case-specific findings across 12 key files. PRIMARY VIOLATIONS: (1) Regex state inference throughout app.py (56-175 lines per function) replacing what should be typed tool outputs — _infer_ndp_workflow_state_from_tool_evidence, _infer_ndp_station_catalog_state_from_tool_evidence, _infer_ndp_search_state_from_tool_evidence, _infer_ndp_profile_state_from_tool_evidence, _infer_ndp_plot_state_from_tool_evidence. (2) Hardcoded domain constants: _EARTHSCOPE_METADATA_RESOURCE_NAMES, _SCAN_LIMITED_EVIDENCE_TOKENS, _UNVERIFIED_GEOSPATIAL_TOKENS, _CONTRADICTORY_MISSING_INPUT_TERMS used as decision gates. (3) String-match routing: if domain == 'earthscope_gnss', if name == 'ndp_filter_earthscope_station_catalog', hardcoded tool name checks throughout app.py:5527, app.py:5533. (4) Hardcoded expert/tool mappings: _EXPERT_TOOLS, _EXPERT_CAPABILITIES (145+ lines) baking domain choreography into Python code instead of pack manifests. (5) Domain-specific tool implementations embedded in core servers (ndp_server.py filter_earthscope_station_catalog, sac_server.py with hardcoded EarthScope URLs). DECISION PRINCIPLE VIOLATION: Throughout app.py, decisions about state, workflow, and routing are embedded in Python conditionals and regex patterns instead of living in the agent/planner. Code runs inference and state-picking (via scoring logic, regex backfill, string matching) instead of running tools and recording data. NON-NEGOTIABLE CLEANUP: All 32 findings must be eliminated before extraction. Decisions must move to agent prompts/signatures. Tools must return typed OutputField results. Domain semantics (EarthScope, GNSS, SAC, geospatial, seismic) belong in clio-kit MCPs and marketplace packs, NOT in /src/clio_agent/ core.

critic.core_decasing_verdict: CLIO Agent core is SEVERELY contaminated with case-specific domain semantics: 58 distinct extraction items must be removed across 13 files. CRITICAL VIOLATION: App.py contains 27+ case-specific functions (prefixed with _infer_ndp_*, _sanitize_geospatial_*, _station_*), 145+ lines of hardcoded expert blueprints (_EXPERT_SPECIALIZATION, _EXPERT_TOOLS, _EXPERT_CAPABILITIES), and 10+ string-match routing decisions hardcoded throughout workflow state inference and planner logic. The 10 in-process domain servers (ndp, sac, genomics, imaging, mass_spec, materials, hpc, and others) are directly coupled to core via gateway mount() calls and hardcoded prefix routing in _infer_tool_server(). The tool catalog (catalog.py) embeds domain-expert ownership (ndp_catalog, sac_format) and case-specific visibility scopes (downwind_impact, geography). Agent.py contains 3 domain-specific blockers and recovery functions hardcoded for SAC/NDP waveform workflows, plus _mass_spec_qc_sentence and _ndp_dataset_names extraction functions. All detected contamination MUST be extracted to function: core agent must become a pure universal framework for orchestration + tool call/result normalization. Decisions about routing, state, workflow progression must move to agent/planner signatures or case-specific expert blueprints in clio-kit MCPs and marketplace packs.
